meta.title: Paired expansion and reverse reconstruction
meta.summary: Three of six Round19 loops are accepted: boundary-consistent clipped clusters, a direct summable product representation, and the complete 48-channel two-cube projector with exact cross Gram. B2 now tests continuous spectral bounds. Parent dense/homogeneous stability, finite-restriction convergence, continuum construction and physical Fibonacci significance remain open.

geometry_hypothesis.title: Double Fibonacci-style golden-spiral work discipline
geometry_hypothesis.claim: The two opposing Fibonacci-style golden/log spirals are an organization-only formula for paired expansion nodes: the forward derivation expands a candidate construction, while the reverse reconstruction asks which premises the target statement would require.
geometry_hypothesis.limit: The SVG uses an approximate logarithmic/golden spiral formula, not exact Fibonacci arcs. No physical test of the geometry has been performed in Round19; its physical role remains an untested hypothesis. Each scientific loop must pass by graph, Haar, min-max, source-bound, and independent comparison checks.

unit_contract.meaning: fixed positive reference energy, E★ > 0, used as the common unit anchor
unit_contract.record: No numeric value is selected by the current Round19 advisor files. Future accepted evidence must preserve one fixed E★ when reporting physical-scale statements.

unit_contract.meaning: dimensionless electric coefficient relative to the fixed reference energy
unit_contract.record: Recorded when a loop supplies accepted physical-scale evidence; A1 currently freezes the requirement for a common α_min > 0.

unit_contract.meaning: dimensionless magnetic-face coefficients relative to the same α
unit_contract.record: The A1 contract bounds |λ_left|/α and |λ_right|/α by 1/2, and |μ_bridge|/α by 1/8, with signs and zeros allowed.

unit_contract.meaning: static Euclidean coefficient kept outside the Hamiltonian energy-scale register
unit_contract.record: κ is kept separate from α/E★ and λ/α. Current C-side static-integral work must not treat κ as physical time matching or as a Hamiltonian energy scale.

loops.title: Boundary-consistent local clusters
loops.scope: Finite open cubic SU(2) rotor graphs with literal restrictions of one local coefficient assignment; no continuum, thermodynamic, or Euclidean κ conclusion is assumed.
loops.result: A1 has an accepted advisor gate for boundary-consistent local clipped components under one fixed infinite selected-face assignment. The result remains finite/local and does not prove dense homogeneous stability or continuum Yang–Mills.
loops.review: The advisor requires every reachable one-face, two-face, and three-face clipped component to be classified with exact signed links and full-link lower estimates before any physical common-scale conclusion is promoted.
loops.next: A1 feeds the A2 product-representation construction; finite clipped-restriction convergence and dense homogeneous stability remain open after Goal A.

loops.title: Product-representation bridge
loops.scope: Accepted direct incomplete product-representation theorem for a summable omitted-face perturbation; it is not finite clipped-restriction convergence.
loops.result: A2 has an accepted advisor gate for the direct product-representation route, including the delta-beta spectral isolation statement in the declared representation when beta < delta.
loops.review: The A2 gate accepts a narrow product-representation theorem and explicitly leaves finite clipped-restriction convergence, homogeneous dense stability, dense limiting spectral passage, continuum scaling, and mass gap open.
loops.next: Advance to B1 under the post-Goal-A advisor decision; keep finite-restriction convergence and the parent dense/homogeneous target open.

loops.title: Complete projector and exact cross Gram
loops.scope: Frozen B1 contract: actual two-cube SU(2) graph, strict electric cutoff E_el < 6α, complete physical channel enumeration, and full exact cross Gram if feasible.
loops.result: Accepted: 48 strict-cutoff states and the full exact cross Gram agree between quaternion and epsilon Haar contractions. At E=6 alpha, 99 label assignments give 107 physical channels through intertwiner multiplicities.
loops.review: The post-Goal-A advisor decision moves to B1 because complement thresholds and exact Gram objects require a complete low-energy physical subspace on the actual graph.
loops.next: Use the enlarged projector and its nonzero compressed magnetic block in B2. The older face-only block estimate cannot be reused unchanged.

evidence.summary: Specifies the SU(2) finite-graph physical contract, forward/backward deliverables, acceptance tests, falsifying controls, and stop condition.

evidence.title: Preliminary boundary classification
evidence.summary: Classifies reachable one-, two-, and three-face clipped components for the A1 boundary-consistency discriminator; it is not a scientific gate.

review.summary: A1, A2 and B1 are accepted within their declared scopes. B1 required threshold-multiplicity, matrix-normalization, source-binding and explicit energy-reference repairs; the final independent comparison passes 24 checks. B2 is running; C remains conditional.
limits: The double-spiral geometry is a hypothesis and work organizer, not physical evidence.
A2 is a direct product-representation theorem, not finite clipped-restriction convergence or homogeneous dense stability.
B1 is accepted on the finite two-cube graph; B2 is running and C remains conditional on later evidence.
No current Round19 file proves a continuum Yang–Mills construction, finite-restriction convergence to the A2 representation, or Clay mass gap.
